Name: Christmas Farm - Decorated Farm House and Greenhouse
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]
Are you having troubles getting into the festive spirit? These Decorations will make sure to get you jolly and bright! 
This mod will decorate your Farm House and Greenhouse during Winter. :) 

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿.
3. Download and unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

To uninstall, just delete it from the mods folder.

This mod doesn't work with other mods that change your Farmhouse and Greenhouse exterior.

[font=Trebuchet MS][size=6]MERRY CHRISTMAS EVERYONE[/size][/font]
